item.text:
ResStock **excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities**, but **includes high-rise apartment buildings** (high-rise multifamily housing), even when building codes classify them as commercial.

This scope follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a housing unit, which excludes congregate housing. Source: [ResStock — Building Types Not Represented in ResStock](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/resources/explanations/Building_Types.html).
